selection_metric: negative macro task mean of parent-mean candidate_matched_ADE_m
condition_fields: current RGB pixels + metric depth + camera calibration
endpoints: unbounded learned xyz offsets from current state; observed geometry is context, not an endpoint surface constraint
target_coordinate_policy: semantic coordinates used only in evaluation; training supervision is recorded route and event
geometry_role: conventional spatial grounding baseline, not claimed core mechanism

cache_config.cache_scope: frozen backbone only; invalid after LoRA/weight updates

geometry_preprocessing.cached_content: raw observed RGB/XYZ/UV/depth/mask only; trainable point features recomputed every forward

sampling_policy: uniform task, uniform positive-reference TRAIN parent within task, uniform instruction within parent; task and parent IDs never enter forward

current_audit.action: Retain every original record and role. Block new cross-split use of flagged tasks pending grouped redesign; do not silently drop or relabel parents.
current_audit.unknown_policy: Missing physical hashes remain unverified; seed uniqueness and hash differences are not independence certificates.
current_audit.scope: Only registration, mechanical_fingerprint.json and reference_pointer.json; no images, paths, reference world or outcomes opened, including locked roles

multitask_model_use_gate.scope: mechanical cross-role audit before model data loading; only snapshot TRAIN/DEV_MODEL observations enter model
